## Personality

Katie Maurice is an imaginary friend and a "little dream girl." However, she is no longer a satisfying presence once a real friend enters the picture.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--katie-maurice.md)

Katie Maurice serves as an imaginary friend and source of comfort for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship exists entirely within Anne's imagination, providing her with companionship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058)_
